name: tree
title: Tree
description: Nested rows that open and close in place, walked with the keyboard (the WAI-ARIA tree pattern): engraved guides per level that light for the branch holding the focus, the set's chevron turning a quarter on the part spring, children landing and leaving with the rows' motion, levels that load on demand with the small-item wait, selection none / single / multiple, the opened row's rail, type-ahead, and F2 to rename with QuickEdit. Tree.Guides and Tree.Disclosure are exported for other rows at a level.
base: none (WAI-ARIA tree pattern; Base UI has no tree)
